company_name: The Japan Institute of Electronics Packaging
semiconductor_relevance: Low — The Japan Institute of Electronics Packaging primarily focuses on research and education in electronics packaging rather than direct semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: The Japan Institute of Electronics Packaging is dedicated to promoting research, education, and international exchange in the field of electronics packaging. They organize conferences and workshops to discuss advancements in chiplet integration and related technologies, aiming to enhance the electronics packaging industry.

regional_presence.Japan: The institute aims to improve the economy and living standards in Japan through its activities in electronics packaging.
